HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulations 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('SEBI Listing ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulations 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ('SEBI Listing Regulations'), we hereby inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors ('the Board') of Susan Electricals India Limited ('the Company') was held today i.e. Monday, November 2, 2026, wherein the Board, inter-alia, considered and approved the following:

1) Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026 in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations together with Limited Review Report, are enclosed herewith as Annexure 1.

HEADLINE: Susan Electricals India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 02/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve This is to inform that ....
MORE: Susan Electricals India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 02/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve This is to inform that pursuant to Regulation 29 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (Listing Regulations), notice is hereby that a Meeting of Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Monday, 2nd November, 2026 at 03:00 PM (IST) inter alia to consider, approve and take on record the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone) of the Company for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026. The Financial Results shall be subject to limited review by Statutory Auditors of the Company.
